# pf-io test fixtures

| File | Size | What |
|---|---|---|
| `layers.psd` | < 2 KB | 8x6 RGB 8-bit PSD: `Background`, group `Group 1` containing `Blue box` (multiply, 50 %) and `Hidden` (screen, hidden flag), and `Top` (difference) at offset (-1,-1). Raw (uncompressed) channels, `lsct` group dividers, Pascal layer names. |
| `flat.psd` | < 100 B | 4x3 RGB PSD with an empty layer section (a flattened file). |

Both are generated by the `psd_writer` module in `../psd_import.rs`, not by Photoshop.
`fixture_file_matches_generator` fails if the checked-in bytes drift from the generator;
regenerate with:

```
cargo test -p pf-io --test psd_import -- --ignored write_fixture
```
